summary: Frontend e2e validation of AdminStock (Stock Phase 4) at /svc/engineer/stock-admin as master admin. All 4 tabs render, drill-down works, transfer mutation succeeded end-to-end with success toast. Stock-take variance logic + post button enablement verified; final post click was blocked by stacked PWA-install / cookie-consent banners (page-level UX issue, not stock-page logic).

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky 'Post N adjustments' button (bottom-4) is obscured by PWA-install-banner (fixed bottom-4 z-[200]) and cookie-consent-banner (z-[100]). On a fresh session a real user cannot click stocktake-post until both banners are dismissed. Same risk applies to transfer-submit.

Error toast 'Only 0 in stock at source — cannot move 1' correctly surfaces backend errors (good). However the From select shows engineer vans by truncated id (e.g. 'Engineer 663ec6') for engineers without a display name — confusing UX. Only the 'Master Admin' van has a real name.

issues: Dark slate tabs/icons readable - the previously reported black-on-dark bug is NOT present in this build (tabs use border-b-2 + blue active state)

action_items: Consider raising z-index of TransferTab/StockTakeTab CTAs above PWA banner (z>=300) or adding bottom padding equal to banner height to avoid click interception.
Improve engineer van label fallback when display name is missing (currently shows truncated UUID prefix).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminStock.js (~542 lines) is acceptable but four sub-components live in one file — fine for now; split if it grows.
axios calls use bearer token from localStorage — consistent with rest of codebase.
Idempotency-Key header sent on transfer (good). Stock-take POST does NOT send an Idempotency-Key — duplicate-submit on slow networks could double-post adjustments.
DetailTab loads ALL 6139 items in one go (no pagination/virtualisation). Rendering 6139 rows works but is heavy on mobile.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (every assertion in the 6 test scenarios passed; only the final stocktake-post click was blocked by an unrelated overlay, but the button state + variance UI were verified correct)

rca of the issue: Stock-take post click failure RCA: Playwright timed out clicking [data-testid='stocktake-post'] because the global cookie-consent-banner (z-[100]) and PWAInstallPrompt banner (z-[200]) both sit at fixed bottom-4 — the same coordinates as the stocktake-post sticky CTA (also bottom-4). Reproduce: open /svc/engineer/stock-admin in a fresh browser session with no cookie consent stored, enter a variance, attempt to click Post — pointer events go to the banner. Mitigation: bump stocktake-post wrapper to z-[300], OR add bottom-spacer/margin equal to banner height (~120px), OR dismiss banners on stock-page mount.
